name: What should I ask a backyard renovation contractor before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a backyard renovation contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a backyard renovation contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a backyard renovation contractor, homeowners should ask questions that reveal both construction skill and project management quality. Important topics include permit handling, drainage strategy, grading, utility routing, timeline expectations, and how changes are managed once work begins. It also helps to ask whether the contractor handles design and construction together or relies on separate vendors, because coordination affects speed and consistency. For Los Angeles projects, experience with local permitting and neighborhood conditions matters a great deal. Ask to see examples of similar work and clarify what is included in the price so the proposal is not full of surprises. A strong contractor should be able to explain sequencing, material lead times, and the risks that could affect the schedule. Clear answers early usually indicate fewer problems later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, drainage, utilities, timeline, scope control, warranty, material sourcing, and whether design and construction are coordinated in-house. The right contractor should explain how the project will handle grading, inspections, and any specialty features before work begins.
